item.title: The Guy Who Kept Arguing
item.description:
Some people genuinely don’t know when to stop talking.

I was in a group chat tonight and one guy kept arguing with everyone about absolutely everything. Nothing serious. Just one of those people who has to correct every sentence somebody writes.

Eventually he started having a go at me specifically.

I told him to leave it.

He didn’t.

Then he started with the usual stuff about how nobody could possibly know who he was because he didn’t use his real name.

item.title: Rainy Sunday
item.description:
It has rained pretty much all day.

I had planned to go out this morning but when I opened the curtains it looked like the entire street had been abandoned, so I went back to bed instead. Woke up again around eleven and spent another twenty minutes convincing myself that getting up was worth it.

Eventually I did.

Made some toast, cleaned the kitchen and then went into town to get a few things. I only needed shampoo and toothpaste but somehow came home with a new hoodie and a takeaway. This happens every time I go shopping.
